mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coding_workspace_registry WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND workspace_ref = #{workspaceRef}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coding_workspace_registry( project_id, workspace_ref, location_ref, safe_display_name, source, status, location_nonce, location_ciphertext, location_digest, physical_fingerprint, created_at_ms, validated_at_ms, revoked_at_ms, revocation_reason_code, version ) VALUES ( #{row.projectId}, #{row.workspaceRef}, #{row.locationRef}, #{row.safeDisplayName}, #{row.source}, #{row.status}, #{row.locationNonce}, #{row.locationCiphertext}, #{row.locationDigest}, #{row.physicalFingerprint}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.validatedAt}, #{row.revokedAt}, #{row.revocationReasonCode}, #{row.version} )
mapper.update: UPDATE coding_workspace_registry SET status = 'DISABLED', revoked_at_ms = #{disabledAt}, revocation_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, validated_at_ms = #{disabledAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND workspace_ref = #{workspaceRef} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
